senses.gloss: m., pl. פְּקוּדִים(b. h. mustered, included in the census.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 121b:8">B. Bath. 121ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 14:29">Num. XIV, 29</cite>) <he>מי שפְּקוּדָיו מבן עשרים … שפקודיו וכ׳</he> every tribe whose members are mustered from twenty years and upward, to the exclusion of the tribe of Levi whose members are enlisted from thirty years.
